historyHint: Discharged people stay in history only — they do not appear on active team cards. Corporate email and team/shift links are released on discharge.
joiningDateHint: Days before this date do not count as absence on the timesheet.
terminationDateHint: Last day employed (inclusive). Leave blank if active. Days after do not count as absence.
deleteConfirm: Delete this user account? This cannot be undone.
exportFilteredHint: Export will include only {{count}} selected department(s).
cannotEditAdmin: Only an Administrator can edit or remove Administrator accounts.
cannotAssignAdmin: HR Assistants cannot create or promote to Administrator.
staffAccountCreated: {{name}} created as {{role}}. No clock link — clock admission checklist skipped.

roleHints.MANAGEMENT: Board / partner — no punch. To administer RH in the app, use Administrator.
roleHints.MANAGER: Team manager — punches and approves team.
roleHints.EMPLOYEE: CLT employee — punches on the clock.

employeeIdPisHint: PIS/NIS with 11–12 digits (payroll/eSocial). Not the number typed on the clock.
clockBiometricRegisteredHint: Check when the fingerprint is already enrolled on the PrintPoint (function 91). This is an RH confirmation — the device cannot reliably list fingerprints.

dmprepChecklist.subtitle: Employee: {{name}}
dmprepChecklist.warning: HR registers the employee and sends them to the PrintPoint. Biometrics (91/92) use Credencial/ID — the clock does not accept PIS.
dmprepChecklist.pullFromDmprepHint: Only to sync employees already in DMPREP. Does not replace HR-first admission.
dmprepChecklist.syncFailed: Failed to pull employees from DMPREP.
dmprepChecklist.dmprepHostHint: PrintPoint SmartPoint B — biometrics on device
dmprepChecklist.dischargeComplete: {{name}} discharged: inactive account, timesheet closed through termination date, clock removal requested. Punch history is kept.
dmprepChecklist.dischargeWarning: Before confirming: remove fingerprints on PrintPoint (function 92) with Credencial/ID — the clock does not accept PIS. Discharge marks INACTIVE, sets termination date, clears timesheet days after that date, and removes the record on the clock (HR history is kept).

step2.title: Send to the clock
step2.detail: Use Send to the clock in the employee panel. The record goes to the PrintPoint (WatchComm).

step3.title: Enroll biometrics on clock
step3.detail: On PrintPoint SmartPoint B: F1 → 91 → supervisor → enter Credencial {{credential}} (not PIS) → 2 fingers. Manual §3.5.

step4.title: Validate punches in HR
step4.detail: After the first punch, status becomes Ready. Automatic collection every Monday at 09:00, or Communication → Collect punches.

step1.title: Delete fingerprints on clock (required)
step1.detail: On PrintPoint: F1 → 92 → supervisor → Credencial {{credential}} (not PIS). Confirm fingerprint deleted. Manual §3.6.

step2.title: Remove record from the clock
step2.detail: Automatic when discharging {{name}} in HR (WatchComm). If the clock is busy, retry under Communication → Employees.

step3.title: Collect final punches (optional)
step3.detail: In Organization → System, click Collect punches if pending marks exist.

step4.title: Delete HR account
step4.detail: Only after deleting fingerprints on the clock (step 1), confirm deletion of {{name}} below.

clockOnboarding.stepExportDetail: Record sent to the PrintPoint via WatchComm. Do not use DMP REP software.

clockGuide.subtitle: SmartPoint B Manual §3.5 and §3.6 — Eletropasso flow: HR sends the record to the clock; biometrics on the device.

admission.overview: HR registers PIS + Credencial and sends them to the PrintPoint. On the clock use Credencial/ID for 91/92 — not PIS.

step1.title: Register in HR
step1.detail: Enter PIS (payroll). The clock Credencial is assigned on save.

step2.title: Send to the clock
step2.detail: Click Send to the clock. The record goes to the PrintPoint. Do not use DMP REP software.

step3.title: Enroll biometrics on clock
step3.detail: PrintPoint function 91: supervisor → Credencial {{credential}} (not PIS) → 2 fingers.

step4.title: Validate punch in HR
step4.detail: After the first punch, status becomes Ready automatically. Automatic collection every Monday at 09:00, or Communication → Collect punches.

discharge.overview: On offboarding, delete fingerprints first (function 92) with Credencial/ID — not PIS.

step2.title: Remove record from the clock
step2.detail: Automatic when discharging {{name}} in HR. If it fails, remove under Communication → Employees.

step3.title: Collect final punches (optional)
step3.detail: Organization → System → Collect punches if pending marks exist.

step4.title: Delete HR account
step4.detail: Only after deleting fingerprints on the clock (step 1), confirm deletion of {{name}}.

manual.admissionSteps: After sending the employee from the Time Clock console (Communication → Employees), on the device: F1 → 91 → E → supervisor PIS/password → E → password → E → credential {{credential}} should already be listed → select employee → E → 1st finger (2 reads) → 2nd finger (2 reads).
manual.dischargeSteps: Prefer removing fingerprint/employee from the Time Clock console. Manual: F1 → 92 → E → supervisor PIS/password → E → password → E → credential {{credential}} → E → confirm deletion.
manual.modelNote: SmartPoint B (Secukey): 2 reads per finger, up to 2 fingerprints per employee. Manual credential typing is only needed if RH send fails.
manual.credentialNotPis: Important: type Credencial/ID. PrintPoint does not accept PIS on the keypad.

warnings.pisMatch: PIS and Credencial may differ. Always use Credencial/ID on the clock.
warnings.bioOnClock: Biometrics are enrolled and deleted only on the physical clock (functions 91 and 92).
warnings.noDmprepRecadastro: After sending to the clock, do not re-register the employee in legacy time-clock software.
warnings.noAutoOffboard: Deleting in HR does not remove biometrics from the clock — use function 92 before deleting the account.

pis.definition: Social ID for payroll/eSocial. Not typed on the PrintPoint keypad.

nsr.definition: Sequential Record Number — each clock operation (fingerprint add/delete) generates an NSR in device memory.

credential.definition: Employee ID on PrintPoint. Used for 91/92. May differ from PIS.

dmprep.definition: Current channel to the clock. HR sends and removes records here; legacy DMP REP is not used for admission.

printpoint.definition: Secukey biometric clock at 192.168.15.201. Admission: function 91. Offboarding: function 92. Punches collected automatically by HR server.

lifecycle.notFound: Employee not found or already removed.
lifecycle.forbidden: You do not have permission for this flow.
lifecycle.admissionPageHint: Send the record to the PrintPoint and enroll the fingerprint on the clock. Then click Done.
lifecycle.dischargePageHint: Check every step (including fingerprint removal on the clock). Only then is Confirm discharge enabled.
lifecycle.simpleDischargeHint: {{name}} ({{role}}) does not use the time clock. Discharge marks the account inactive and sets the termination date — HR history is kept.

clockCredentialHint: Short PrintPoint ID (e.g. 98). Not the PIS. Operators cannot edit — the system assigns it.
clockCredentialAutoHint: The system assigns the next free number (96, 97, 98…). Use it in clock function 91. PIS stays in Official ID.
clockCredentialNotApplicable: Not applicable (contractor / no clock — no credential)
